titleEn: Sync templates and review status from Meta

readOnlyPost.reason: Pulls Meta's current templates into local state and sends nothing to Meta or to any customer; the only write is the local copy, which Meta can overwrite again.

undo.note: local copy only; running it again restores Meta's answer

ar: عملت قالب في WhatsApp Manager ومش ظاهر
en: My template status did not update, how do I sync?

steps: Press "Sync with Meta" on the Templates screen
Status also updates by Meta's webhook, and a template pending for an hour is re-read from Meta automatically
edgeCases: Meta unreachable or rate-limited: 503 rate_limited, retry shortly; nothing is lost
Own number not connected: 404 no_active_number (a store on the shared number sees the platform templates instead, never an empty list)
Connection to WhatsApp expired or closed: 503 token_unavailable, reconnect the number on the Numbers screen
Templates Meta no longer lists are removed from the local list; a submission still on its way to Meta is kept
assistantNote: free: pulls state from Meta, sends nothing
